description: Your sending domain has been added to Xem. There are a few DNS records to put in place before it can send email.
name: Let’s connect your sending domain
preheader: Open managed sending and add the ownership record to your DNS provider.
subject: Let’s connect your sending domain

description: Xem has verified your domain ownership. Next, we’ll check the records that help receiving servers trust your email.
name: Your domain ownership is verified
preheader: Add the DKIM, MAIL FROM and DMARC records shown in your workspace.
subject: Your domain ownership is verified

description: Your domain passed the required authentication checks. Sending still depends on your workspace approval and current account status.
name: Your sending domain passed its checks
preheader: Review your approval status and choose the address you want to send from.
subject: Your sending domain passed its checks

description: Your workspace has been approved for Xem managed sending. Your current sending allowance is available in the dashboard.
name: Your workspace is approved for managed sending
preheader: Connect a sender on a verified domain, then send a test to your own inbox.
subject: Your workspace is approved for managed sending

description: Your approved workspace now has a connected managed sender. It is available when composing emails and setting up campaigns.
name: Your managed sender is connected
preheader: Send a test to your own inbox and check its delivery status before your first campaign.
subject: Your managed sender is connected

description: Xem has queued your test email. Queued means it is waiting to be submitted to the email provider.
name: Your sending test is queued
preheader: Follow the test in managed sending. This notification does not confirm delivery.
subject: Your sending test is queued

description: The email provider accepted your test for sending. This is not yet confirmation that the receiving server accepted it.
name: The provider accepted your sending test
preheader: Check delivery events in your workspace and look in your inbox and spam folder.
subject: The provider accepted your sending test

description: The provider reported that the receiving mail server accepted your test email. Inbox placement can still vary.
name: Your test reached the receiving mail server
preheader: Review the email in your mailbox. You’re ready to prepare your first campaign.
subject: Your test reached the receiving mail server

description: Your test did not reach a confirmed successful outcome. Its latest status and next steps are available in your workspace.
name: Your sending test needs attention
preheader: Review the message status before sending another test, especially if its outcome is unknown.
subject: Your sending test needs attention

description: Welcome to Xem. Your account is ready, and there’s room to make your email feel like you.
name: Welcome to Xem
preheader: Explore the template library, connect a sender when you’re ready, and send a test to yourself.
subject: Welcome to Xem

description: We received a request to reset your Xem password. Use the button below to choose a new one. This link expires 15 minutes after it was requested and can be used once.
name: Reset your Xem password
preheader: If you didn’t request this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same until you choose a new one.
subject: Reset your Xem password

description: The password for your Xem account was successfully changed. Existing sign-in sessions have been revoked; sign in again with your new password.
name: Your Xem password has changed
preheader: If this wasn’t you, reset your password immediately and contact your workspace administrator or support.
subject: Your Xem password has changed

description: More emails than usual failed to send from your workspace today. This usually means a sender is unavailable, its credentials need attention, or a provider is rejecting messages. The most common reasons are listed below.
name: Emails are failing to send from your workspace
preheader: Check the sender settings for the reasons below, then review the sending logs. Some failures may already be scheduled for another attempt, so check the latest status before retrying.
subject: Emails are failing to send from your workspace

description: Email providers reported more delivery delays than usual for your workspace today. A delay is not a confirmed failure, and providers may still be retrying.
name: Email deliveries are being delayed
preheader: Check the latest delivery events before sending another copy. Give the providers’ retry process time to finish.
subject: Email deliveries are being delayed

description: Several sending acknowledgements were interrupted or could not be confirmed today. The provider or receiving server may already have accepted those emails.
name: Some delivery outcomes are uncertain
preheader: Review provider events and sending logs before resending. Retrying an uncertain message can create a duplicate.
subject: Some delivery outcomes are uncertain

description: Email providers reported more bounces than usual for your workspace today. Permanent bounces are added to suppression so future sends do not keep targeting unreachable addresses.
name: More emails than usual are bouncing
preheader: Review the bounce reasons below and check where these contacts came from. A sudden rise often points to an old or purchased list. Don’t remove a suppression until you have verified the address.
subject: More emails than usual are bouncing

description: Several recipients reported your emails as spam today. Complaining recipients are suppressed, and managed sending may be suspended for review if complaints continue.
name: Recipients are reporting your emails as spam
preheader: Review audience consent and your recent campaigns. Make the unsubscribe link easy to find, and don’t send again to recipients who complained.
subject: Recipients are reporting your emails as spam

description: Managed sending for your workspace was suspended. Review the latest account status before attempting new sends.
name: Managed sending has been suspended
preheader: Open managed sending, review recent delivery feedback, and contact support or your administrator before resuming.
subject: Managed sending has been suspended

description: A contact import in your workspace failed today, so its contacts were not added. The reason is listed below.
name: A contact import failed
preheader: Check the file and its column mapping, then try the import again from the list it was meant for.
subject: A contact import failed

description: Several automation runs failed in your workspace today, so some contacts did not get the next step of their journey. The most common reasons are listed below.
name: Automations are failing in your workspace
preheader: Open your automations, check the steps named in the reasons below, and fix them before more contacts reach them.
subject: Automations are failing in your workspace
